evidence: Review for Ticket t_b0pzgp9m (retire the old live streams). The routes GET /api/changes, GET /api/navigation/view/events, GET /api/conversation/conversations/<id>/view/tail and GET /api/conversation/conversations/<id>/tail are removed. Builds 13 to 15 follow live updates over those routes (ChangeStream.swift, the navigation view events reader and the view tail reader), so they break. Build 16 follows all four feeds over the one WebSocket /api/live (LiveSocket.swift, Ticket t_d63xse5t, pull request 1385), so MINIMUM_SUPPORTED_BUILD rises from 13 to 16 and the desktop bridge floor rises from 2 to 3 (bridge 3 gives the page its socket address and identity). The raise is in the same release as the removal, and the floor check runs before any route, so an older client gets 426 ios_update_required or desktop_update_required and not a dead stream. Native reads and actions are otherwise unchanged: no key is added, removed or retyped on any route that build 16 calls. Live check: a private test-host server from this branch on a fresh database. Build 16 requests to the four removed paths returned 404. A build 16 read returned 200 and published minimum_build 16 and minimum_bridge_version 3. Build 15 reads and a build 15 request to /api/changes returned 426 ios_update_required. Desktop bridge 3 read returned 200, and bridge 2 reads and a bridge 2 request to /api/changes returned 426 desktop_update_required. The desktop notification stream /api/notifications/desktop opened as an event stream for bridge 3. A build 16 WebSocket received ready then the conversation_view snapshot, and a build 15 socket was closed with code 4001 update needed. scripts/release-prep/ios_probe.mjs at build 16 ran 41 records on the same kind of host: its build 15 read, send and decision returned 426, and two next-build notification records (apns device and live activity report) returned 400 agent_forbidden, which this review did not compare with the earlier server. The server was stopped by its own PID. The probe is artifacts/retired_streams_probe.mjs on that Ticket. Untested: a signed device, TestFlight distribution of build 16, and a signed desktop app with bridge 3 against this server. The raise must ship only after the owner's own iPhone and Mac run the socket builds. Publish iPhone build 16 and the desktop app with bridge 3 with this release. Production deployment remains a later owner action.
